title: Gas leak and ignition
goal: Show conditional gas-leak outcomes through detection, isolation, and ignition control.

rubric.must: The initiating event Pressurised gas leak and its frequency are visible at the left.
Ordered function columns visibly show gas detection, automatic isolation, and ignition-source control.
Terminal branches visibly distinguish safe isolation, fire, and escalation outcomes.
Each safety-function column visibly shows complementary success and failure branch probabilities.
Success and failure paths are visibly traceable from the initiator to terminal outcomes.
The left-to-right event-tree sequence remains legible without ambiguous crossings.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/eventtree/ideal.svg (sha256 064a513719ee), source sha256 c527e1a22b87. Independent orthogonal event tree with success above failure, pruned wildcard branches, complementary probabilities, aligned outcome table, and independently multiplied sequence frequencies; their sum equals the initiating frequency. No invented severity classes. All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
